sections.title: Simulating Alternate Realities
sections.content: To compare a real experience to a hypothetical scenario ('as if... had happened'), Hungarian uses *mintha* followed by the conditional mood with *volna*.

items.spanish: Úgy viselkedett, mintha semmi sem történt volna.
items.english: He acted as if nothing had happened.

items.spanish: Olyan csend volt a teremben, mintha mindenki elment volna.
items.english: There was such silence in the room as if everyone had left.

items.spanish: Úgy örült a sikernek, mintha megnyerte volna a főnyereményt.
items.english: She was as overjoyed at the success as if she had won the grand prize.
